title: The Moat
blurb: The sihek, or Guam kingfisher, is Extinct in the Wild. Plotting every kingfisher ND2 sequence in GenBank by its distance from this one bird reveals a ring 2.02 percentage points wide containing nothing at all. The chart inks the emptiness and leaves the data as dust.
